name: Stabilise residual BUBR1 protein through NAD+/SIRT2 regulation
rationale: BUBR1 abundance is reported to depend on SIRT2 and NAD+ (acetylation at lysine 668). If the missense allele makes protein that is lost by turnover, raising NAD+ might protect it. Direction of effect is disputed (acetylation at lysine 250 acts the other way).
grounding: missense variant in the BUB1B kinase domain
second BUB1B variant is truncating, so residual protein would come from the missense allele
unknowns: whether the missense protein is made and how stable it is
net effect of SIRT2 on BUBR1

name: Read through the premature stop codon
rationale: A truncating variant could in principle be read through by small molecules that let the ribosome continue, producing some full-length protein. Efficiency depends on codon context and on escape from nonsense-mediated decay.

name: Tumour-context agents for aneuploid cells
rationale: MVA predisposes to childhood cancers including rhabdomyosarcoma. If a tumour develops, agents that exploit the stress of aneuploid cells may be relevant. The genome (germline blood) cannot show whether such a tumour exists or its genotype.
unknowns: tolerance of chemotherapy in constitutional aneuploidy
